message.content:
Since  
\[
2293 = 31\cdot 73 + 30
\]
and  
\[
31 = 30\cdot 1 + 1,
\]
we can use the Euclidean algorithm to find the inverse of \(31\) modulo \(2293\):

\[
1 = 31 - 30
\]
\[
30 = 2293 - 31\cdot 73
\]
so
\[
1 = 31 - (2293 - 31\cdot 73)
\]
\[
1 = 31\cdot 74 - 2293.
\]

Thus,
\[
31\cdot 74 \equiv 1 \pmod{2293},
\]
so the inverse of \(31\) modulo \(2293\) is \(74\).

Therefore,
\[
n \equiv 3\cdot 74 \equiv 222 \pmod{2293}.
\]

Since \(0\leq 222<2293\), the answer is \(222\).

The answer is 222.
